text_blocks.snippet: Fibrocystic breast changes, previously known as fibrocystic breast disease, are a common, benign condition characterized by lumpy, painful, or tender breasts. While these changes can be uncomfortable, they are not a disease and are not associated with an increased risk of breast cancer. These changes are often cyclical, with symptoms like lumpiness and pain worsening before menstruation and improving afterward.
